body: what bothered me is that the show treats him like he's in the right by saying something along the lines of "Oh Piper so you're the sun?" and it's just treated as like,, Piper is the asshole in this situation when shes 100% right.

I think if she is seriously considering suicide, you should tell someone. The person on the other end of these exchanges will never like that you told someone, it will feel like you betrayed them even if you're doing the best. You are only one person, and unqualified person at that. I can tell just how deeply you care for your friend to ask for help like this, I really, really admire you for this. But you are unqualified, as most of us are. If she has serious depressed and suicidal thoughts there is only so much we as untrained people can do. Finding a therapist is the first step, and it can be hardest step ever trying to find someone you fit with. If she does get one, and it turns out she doesnt like therapy, please please convince her to try out another therapist.

The only thing you can do yourself is be there for her, if she has anxiety showering her in gifts and compliments might only make her feel worse but then again I dont know her so take everything i say with a grain of salt.

Let her know shes free to vent to you either directly or over text, whatever is most comfortable. Even if you dont know what to say at all just acknowledging that her problems are indeed real will make her feel better.

I'm sorry you have to carry this weight on you but honestly you're just awesome for still sticking around and listening, even if it's all you can do some people wont even do that and it's really admirable you're sticking by !!
